title: DAO Dapp Store
tagline: Non-custodial wallets with multiple private keys distributions. Supporting simple switch between layer1 and layer2 and vice versa. DAO Based application – Holders can vote on anything related to the DappStore.
description:
DAO DappStore vision:
Non-custodial wallets with multiple private keys distributions.
Supporting simple switch between layer1 and layer2 and vice versa.
DAO Based application – The community can vote on anything related to the DappStore.

Accelerate and support Ethereum's adoption and transition to layer-2 solutions by creating a one-stop-shop for all defi, nfts, daos and all other dapps, in a simple to navigate, access and transition between layer-1 to different layer-2 and solutions.

The protocol will be open to anyone to contribute and build upon it and will be governed by the community.
Participates of the DAO DappStore can vote and help shape the future of Ethereum's dapps landscape by voting and giving grants to promising dapps, those selected dapps will be also featured on the DappStore main page.

DappStoreDAO is an Appstore for the community governed by the community.


DAO DappStore mission:
Invest – Invest in early-stage ideas and products and be the first to identify potential and kickstart promising dapps.

Foster – Foster growth of new dapps. Launched startups are featured in the DappStoreDAO for accelerated adoption.

Grants – Provide grants for individuals and emerging teams with a great project and give them "the first push".

Build – The community will help startups and dapps grow, if they need help with development, they can ask and get access to wide range of developers and new community members.

Hackathons – Arrange hackathons to find best ideas and teams and help them grow together.

And always open for more ideas(:
how_its_made:
I used react native, wanted to try many of the presented technologies but couldn't find the time to try it all. wish I had more spare time and more teammates so I could build something more impressive.

I feel like I learned a lot during the hackathon and can't wait to learn more and dive even deeper(:
